contracts.action: The three operator CI jobs (test-local, test-remote, test-olm) now use the third-party action manusa/actions-setup-minikube at v2.16.1 instead of v2.13.1.
contracts.equivalent_path: The same action is used at lines 70, 114 and 158. No other workflow in .github uses it, so all of its uses moved together.
contracts.before_after: Before: the action was pinned to tag v2.13.1. After: it is pinned to tag v2.16.1. The inputs passed to it ('minikube version', 'kubernetes version', 'github token', 'driver', 'start args') did not change. The minikube and Kubernetes versions still come from env MINIKUBE_VERSION v1.32.0 and KUBERNETES_VERSION v1.27.10.
contracts.visible_effect: Only CI is affected. If the new action version handles these inputs differently, the minikube setup step fails or behaves differently, and the Status Check job reports that.
contracts.failure_mode: If the action fails, the setup step fails the job. The 'check' job runs with if: always() and passes the needs results to the status-check action, so a failure shows up in CI and is not silent. The upstream changes between v2.13.1 and v2.16.1 are outside this repository and cannot be checked by reading it. The action is pinned by mutable tag, not by commit SHA, the same as before.

summary: This is a Dependabot bump of manusa/actions-setup-minikube from v2.13.1 to v2.16.1. It changes all three uses of the action in operator-ci.yml, and the action is used nowhere else in the repository. The inputs passed to the action and the pinned minikube and Kubernetes versions are unchanged. If the new version breaks setup, the failure shows in CI through the always-run status check job. I found no issues.
